Lemon Network Solutions

Plan a business network online, see the real equipment and prices, and receive a 10-page project book that is both the design and the quote.

Visit the site ↗How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Network quotes usually arrive as a table of part numbers after several phone calls. The owner cannot see what they are buying, and the installer cannot install from it.

02

What it does

A planner sizes the system from a few answers (building type, area, floors, users, systems needed) and builds an estimate from real product photos, list prices and labor. A paid consultation reserves the project and is credited to it. Each client receives a project book: design and port map, WiFi coverage, cameras and door access, rack and cabling, bill of materials, timeline and signature page. The site also has 16 case studies, 39 UniFi lessons, the full catalogue and two technical books.

03

How it is built

Next.js, with large content pulled from a CDN at build time. The planner and the project book use the same sizing rules, so the estimate and the final quote match. Drawings are made on the client's floor plans and exported to PDF.
